artifact_schema.description: A sealed bound record, schema ecbench.bound/v1, as aburan28/crypto's ecbench writes it (docs/bounds/README.md there), with every non-integer number carried as its shortest round-trip decimal string, because this network's canonical encoding has no floats. artifacts/prime-rho-neg.json is a committed record rendered that way and scores 682064; artifacts/prime-bsgs-neg.json scores 866743; artifacts/tampered-mean-gae.json is the first with one count altered, and is refused.

bound_id.description: ECBND1h followed by 12 hex digits: the measuring repository's SHA-256 of the record's bytes with this field empty. Named, not recomputed here -- the rendering changes the bytes.

domain.description: problem ecdlp.single_target, family prime, target_kind planted, unit ecbench.gae, tier toy, envelope one cold target without precomputation.

sizes.description: One row per curve: slug, r, field_bits <= 32, automorphisms_available, floor_s, runs == verified > 0, mean_gae, mean_s, ratio_to_floor; every stated figure recomputes from the counts.

constant.description: ratio_to_floor.value equals the run-weighted mean of the sizes' ratios.

dimensions.description: ops.known true and ops.value equal to constant.ratio_to_floor.value.

provenance.description: sessions named by directory, session id and the SHA-256 of records.jsonl; verified equal to the sum over sizes.

statement: Bring a measured ECDLP method as close to the generic collision floor as the counts allow, in one domain: the ecdlp.single_target problem on prime-field curves with planted targets, in group-addition equivalents (ecbench.gae; the whole method, cold, one target, no precomputation), at the toy tier (fields of at most 32 bits). Submit a sealed ecbench bound record (schema ecbench.bound/v1) with its non-integer numbers as decimal strings. Score is parts per million of the floor sqrt(pi / 2A) sqrt(r) achieved, maximised: the pinned evaluator recomputes every size's S = mean_gae / sqrt(r) and its ratio to the floor from the record's own counts, the pooled ratio from the sizes, the tier from the field sizes and the domain from its fields, so a declared headline counts for nothing. A record that disagrees with itself, measures time, lies outside this domain or tier, or is not admissible scores 0 and is rejected. Baseline 500000 (a method spending twice the floor's group additions; the committed rho.negation record reaches 682064 and bsgs.negation 866743), target 1000000, the floor itself. The evaluator cannot verify that the sessions a record names exist and replay -- that is the measuring repository's CI and a replay receipt cited by hash inside the record -- so an accept is a receipt for a well-formed, self-consistent frontier entry and nothing stronger. Payment is proportional to the distance the frontier moves, and every submission must cite the frontier it beat.
